text: {"features":[{"name":"Security automation insight","description":"How clearly the letter understands the role as building automation that scales security work, vulnerability handling, and risk reduction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only generic interest in security or software work and does not identify automation as the core problem."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions automation or manual workload in passing but gives little sense of the specific security challenge the team addresses."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Recognizes that the role involves automating security processes or vulnerability handling, but the framing stays fairly general."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly explains the role as scaling scarce security expertise through tooling such as triage, vulnerability response, or variant analysis."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a sharp, role-specific view of security as a systems problem where agentic automation expands capacity across the development lifecycle and reduces expert bottlenecks."}]},{"name":"Platform mindset","description":"How strongly the letter values central infrastructure work whose benefits compound across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention foundational infrastructure or organization-wide leverage."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in scale in broad terms without tying it to central platform work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a clear attraction to infrastructure or broad impact beyond a single product."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Emphasizes the multiplier effect of central tooling or platform improvements that many teams inherit."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Builds a compelling case around platform leverage, repeatedly framing impact as improving security once in a way that benefits the whole organization."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security engineering as helping developers do the secure thing through better defaults, tooling, and lower friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not discuss serving developer teams or improving their workflow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests helping engineers in general terms but without a concrete view of how security tooling should support them."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions secure defaults, lower manual work, or reducing friction for engineers."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly frames good security tooling as something developers can adopt easily inside normal workflows."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes developer enablement a central theme, arguing persuasively that security succeeds when tooling makes the secure path the easiest path."}]},{"name":"Production software experience","description":"How strongly the letter evidences hands-on experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software over time.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides only minimal qualifying evidence, with limited time in role or very small production scope."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some production experience, but the scope or ownership described remains modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid qualifying experience with multiple years and clear work on production services through testing, maintenance, or launch."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production experience with stronger tenure or a broader record of launched and maintained services."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows extensive, clearly relevant production ownership that signals mature experience with live systems across the full product lifecycle."}]},{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"How strongly the letter presents formal technical education as a relevant strength for the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions only a bachelor's degree as a baseline credential without any signal of advanced preparation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Presents a bachelor's degree clearly but without any added sense of technical depth beyond the minimum."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a master's degree in a relevant field as part of the background."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents advanced graduate training as meaningful preparation, typically through a master's degree emphasized as a strength or a doctorate mentioned briefly."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents a doctorate in computer science or a related field as a clear differentiator for the role."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"How strongly the letter shows production experience using Go for back-end or infrastructure work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only in passing and gives little indication it is a meaningful working language."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States some Go use but provides limited sense of depth or centrality."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is a regular production language in the applicant's work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows Go as a primary language or the backbone of back-end systems the applicant has built."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Positions Go as the principal language for substantial production infrastructure or back-end work closely matching the job."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates Python experience relevant to services, tooling, automation, or agents.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or gives no evidence of real use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly or in a way that sounds secondary and lightweight."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows credible Python use for tooling, services, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong day-to-day Python use in production systems or core internal tooling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep Python capability, such as extensive production use for services, automation, or typed and tested tooling others rely on."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing systems that give agents bounded autonomy under explicit control.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or autonomous task execution."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agentic or AI systems broadly without describing architecture or controls."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building agentic workflows or pipelines at a high level."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes end-to-end agentic system design with clear roles for agents and control infrastructure."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated agentic architecture with explicit constraints, auditing, permissions, or other guardrails that closely match the role."}]},{"name":"AI production experience","description":"How strongly the letter evidences building and operating AI features in production settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention AI experience."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure without concrete shipped work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States direct work on AI or large-language-model features in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows meaningful production AI experience plus attention to reliability, evaluation, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong applied AI experience with shipped model-backed features and explicit practices for hardening, evaluation, or trustworthy operation."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, deduplication, routing, or related workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention vulnerability handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Refers to reducing manual security work in general terms without a concrete vulnerability workflow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes some direct work on vulnerability report triage or handling automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes building a clear vulnerability pipeline, such as classification, routing, deduplication, or queue automation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows substantial ownership of vulnerability automation with concrete pipeline design and a clear reduction in manual workload."}]},{"name":"Security assessment depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience assessing systems for security issues through review, threat modeling, or hands-on probing.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of performing security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Signals general security awareness but little or no direct assessment work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States credible hands-on security assessment experience."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes meaningful assessment work with concrete methods such as threat models, code review, or broad system reviews."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong assessment depth through formal or hands-on reviews of new and existing systems plus follow-through on findings or remediation."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic reasoning","description":"How strongly the letter evidences practical command of algorithms and data structures in solving system problems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention algorithmic work at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength without a concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives one concrete example of using an algorithm or data structure to improve a system."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong practical algorithmic thinking through a clear and consequential redesign example."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents algorithmic reasoning as a distinctive strength through especially crisp examples of turning bottlenecks or messy systems into tractable designs."}]},{"name":"Independent security practice","description":"How strongly the letter shows self-driven development of security skills outside ordinary job claims.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no extra signal of security practice beyond general interest."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions light external engagement, such as occasional competitions or a basic certification."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a meaningful extra signal, such as regular competition participation or a baseline security certification."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong independent security practice, such as demanding certification or consistently strong competition results."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional outside security credibility through high-level offensive practice, a demanding hands-on certification, or both."}]},{"name":"Independent engineering initiative","description":"How strongly the letter shows self-directed technical work beyond core job duties through open-source stewardship or substantial personal builds.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of technical initiative outside regular work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small personal utility or an occasional minor contribution."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows some sustained outside work, such as occasional upstream patches or a modest personal project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear self-directed initiative through maintained open-source work or a substantial personal system."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional initiative through stewardship of externally used open-source software or an ambitious systems project pursued with production-like rigor."}]},{"name":"Impact evidence","description":"How well the letter supports its claims with concrete examples, scope, and observable outcomes.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on assertions and provides little specific evidence or result."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gives a few specifics but leaves scope, ownership, or outcome mostly unclear."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several claims with concrete examples, though the resulting impact is only partly clear."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Uses specific achievements and scope to make impact believable, such as named workflows, services, or workload reduction."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently backs claims with concrete work and clear outcomes, including strong scope signals or operational results that make the contribution highly credible."}]},{"name":"Narrative cohesion","description":"How clearly the letter is organized into a logical, readable case rather than a disjointed list of points.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as fragmented or hard to follow, with abrupt shifts and weak overall flow."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a basic structure but feels choppy, repetitive, or list-like."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally coherent and readable, though transitions or emphasis are only adequate."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Flows well through motivation, evidence, and fit in a deliberate sequence."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally cohesive, with a strong through-line that makes the argument easy to follow and remember."}]},{"name":"Mechanical accuracy","description":"How free the letter is from spelling, grammar, punctuation, and proofreading errors that distract from credibility.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent errors that repeatedly interrupt reading and signal weak proofreading."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains many noticeable errors, though the overall meaning remains understandable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains a moderate number of errors or awkward slips that are noticeable but not overwhelming."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Contains only a few minor errors that rarely distract."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and professionally polished."}]}]}
